clo_details: Describe how generative AI models work at an intuitive, non-mathematical level.
Apply prompt engineering techniques to obtain useful, reliable outputs from generative models.

Build a small generative AI application end to end, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output validation, basic agent/tool use, and an appropriate customization strategy (prompting, RAG, or fine-tuning).
Evaluate generative AI outputs and systems using rubrics, test sets, model-as-judge methods, and analysis of failure modes.
Analyze the ethical, social, legal, and governance implications of generative AI and apply responsible-use practices.
